mapper.sql: select id, play_instance_id, member_id, activity_id, topic_id, node_id, status, checkin_time, pic_url, review_status, longitude, latitude, puzzle_score, completion_mode, del_flag, create_time from player_node_progress
mapper.select: select count(distinct member_id) from player_node_progress where topic_id = #{topicId} and del_flag = 0
mapper.insert:
insert into player_node_progress
play_instance_id, member_id, activity_id, topic_id, node_id, status, checkin_time, pic_url, review_status, longitude, latitude, puzzle_score, completion_mode, del_flag, create_time,
#{playInstanceId}, #{memberId}, #{activityId}, #{topicId}, #{nodeId}, #{status}, #{checkinTime}, #{picUrl}, #{reviewStatus}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{puzzleScore}, #{completionMode}, #{delFlag}, #{createTime},
mapper.update: update player_node_progress set pic_url = #{picUrl}, review_status = 0 where id = #{id} and status in (0, 1) and del_flag = 0 and pic_url is null
update player_node_progress set status = 1, review_status = 1, checkin_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 0 and del_flag = 0
mapper.select: select max(session_score) from ( select coalesce(p.activity_id, 0) as session_id, sum(coalesce(p.puzzle_score, 0)) as session_score, count(distinct p.node_id) as done_count, count(distinct case when p.puzzle_score is not null then p.node_id end) as puzzle_count from player_node_progress p join cms_topic_node pn on pn.id = p.node_id and pn.status = 1 and (pn.merchant_member_id is null or pn.node_audit_status = 1) and not exists (select 1 from merchant_chapter_offer withdrawn where withdrawn.chapter_id = pn.chapter_id and withdrawn.merchant_id = pn.merchant_member_id and withdrawn.status = 0 and withdrawn.withdraw_reason is not null and trim(withdrawn.withdraw_reason) != '') where p.member_id = #{memberId} and p.topic_id = #{topicId} and p.status = 1 and p.del_flag = 0 group by coalesce(p.activity_id, 0),p.play_instance_id ) scored_session where scored_session.done_count = ( select count(*) from cms_topic_node n where n.topic_id = #{topicId} and n.status = 1 and (n.merchant_member_id is null or n.node_audit_status = 1) and not exists (select 1 from merchant_chapter_offer withdrawn where withdrawn.chapter_id = n.chapter_id and withdrawn.merchant_id = n.merchant_member_id and withdrawn.status = 0 and withdrawn.withdraw_reason is not null and trim(withdrawn.withdraw_reason) != '') ) and scored_session.puzzle_count = ( select count(*) from cms_topic_node n join cms_member_template t on t.id = n.template_id where n.topic_id = #{topicId} and n.status = 1 and (n.merchant_member_id is null or n.node_audit_status = 1) and not exists (select 1 from merchant_chapter_offer withdrawn where withdrawn.chapter_id = n.chapter_id and withdrawn.merchant_id = n.merchant_member_id and withdrawn.status = 0 and withdrawn.withdraw_reason is not null and trim(withdrawn.withdraw_reason) != '') and t.validation_method in (1, 3) ) and scored_session.puzzle_count > 0

select p.member_id as memberId, m.nickname as nickname, m.avatar as avatar, count(*) as score, max(p.checkin_time) as finishedAt from player_node_progress p left join ums_member m on m.id = p.member_id where p.del_flag = 0 and p.status = 1 and p.play_instance_id=coalesce((select r.play_instance_id from topic_route_session r where r.member_id=p.member_id and r.topic_id=p.topic_id and r.activity_id=p.activity_id order by r.id desc limit 1),'default') and p.activity_id = #{activityId} and p.topic_id = #{topicId} and p.activity_id = 0 group by p.member_id, m.nickname, m.avatar order by score desc, max(p.checkin_time) asc, p.member_id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.sql: select r.member_id as memberId, m.nickname as nickname, m.avatar as avatar, (select count(*) from player_node_progress p where p.member_id = r.member_id and p.activity_id = r.activity_id and p.topic_id = r.topic_id and p.play_instance_id = r.play_instance_id and p.status = 1 and p.del_flag = 0) as score, case when r.status = 1 then 1 else 0 end as reachedEnding, case when r.status = 1 and r.completed_at is not null then timestampdiff(SECOND, r.create_time, r.completed_at) end as elapsedSeconds, case when r.status = 1 then r.completed_at end as finishedAt from topic_route_session r left join ums_member m on m.id = r.member_id where r.topic_id = #{topicId} and r.activity_id = #{activityId} and r.id = (select max(x.id) from topic_route_session x where x.member_id = r.member_id and x.topic_id = r.topic_id and x.activity_id = r.activity_id)
mapper.select: order by case when r.status = 1 then 0 else 1 end asc, case when r.status = 1 and r.completed_at is not null then timestampdiff(SECOND, r.create_time, r.completed_at) else 2147483647 end asc, score desc, r.member_id asc limit #{limit}
